title: MioCommerce Review (2026)
intro: MioCommerce is evaluated here as field service operations software for home and commercial service businesses — live pricing booking pages, scheduling/dispatch, CRM, invoicing, and payments. Essentials from $19/mo annual with a 15-day free trial. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management / field-service methodology, scoring products inside their job cluster. It is based on first-party research (miocommerce.com, 2026-09-06), not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose MioCommerce when in-field service booking, scheduling, and invoicing need one ops system — not when you need a generic tech project-management suite.
verdict: Choose MioCommerce when live pricing booking pages plus scheduling, dispatch, CRM, and payments for home/commercial services is the job. Compare ServiceM8 and Contractor Foreman for overlapping trades FSM. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-09-06 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm live Grow/ProMax amounts on the vendor pricing page before purchase.

faq.question: Is MioCommerce still an active product?
faq.answer: Yes — miocommerce.com is live with pricing, LLM info, and a 15-day trial as of the 2026-09-06 research pass.

faq.question: What category does MioCommerce belong in?
faq.answer: Field service operations for home and commercial service businesses — booking, scheduling, dispatch, CRM, invoicing — not a general ecommerce storefront platform.

sections.heading: What MioCommerce is for
sections.body: MioCommerce targets in-field service SMBs that need to sell services online with live pricing/availability, then run scheduling, dispatch, CRM, invoicing, and payments in one system. The editorial job is field-service operations — not a Shopify replacement for physical goods and not a generic tech PM tool.

sections.heading: Pricing model
sections.body: Verified Essentials at $19/mo annual from the official pricing page and Startup at $67/mo annual from the vendor’s April 2026 plan announcement. Grow and ProMax are treated as confirm-live / contactSales in this research pass because fixed public amounts were not confidently captured for every tier. A 15-day trial without credit card is advertised.

sections.heading: How MioCommerce differs from ServiceM8
sections.body: Both sit in field-service operations. MioCommerce emphasizes live pricing booking pages and service ecommerce enablement; ServiceM8 is a more established trades FSM with published Growing/Premium ladders. Prefer based on booking-page needs versus mature trades dispatch packaging — and verify live quotes on both vendors.

testingNotes: No SoftwareGlimpse hands-on lab session. Research-only review.
